name: Karmanye Vadhikaraste
teaching: Perform your prescribed duty without attachment to the fruits of action.

name: Samatvam Yoga Ucyate
teaching: Equanimity in success and failure is called Yoga.

name: Mithyacara
teaching: Restraining actions while dwelling on desires is foolish hypocrisy; honest work is superior.

name: Samadarsina
teaching: The wise look with equal vision upon all beings with humility.

name: Atmaiva Hy Atmano Bandhur
teaching: Elevate yourself by yourself; the mind is a friend to the self-controlled, an enemy to the unbridled.

name: Amanitvam Adambhitvam
teaching: Humility, unpretentiousness, non-violence, forgiveness, and purity constitute true knowledge.

name: Phala Tyaga
teaching: Actions should be performed as duty, relinquishing attachment and desire for reward.

name: Jnana Yajna
teaching: The sacrifice of knowledge is superior to material sacrifice; all action culminates in knowledge.
